not_confirmed_list.value: Marisol Valvulas manufactures industrial gate and globe valves for the oil and gas industry. It is headquartered in Valencia, Spain, and exports to customers across Europe.
Brookline Valves manufactures needle valves and manifolds for instrumentation. It is majority-owned by Holmfirth Equity Partners, a private equity investor.
